answer: Copied passes fail a timed sky watch. The applicant locks 39 coins and must stand on a published harbor jetty at the seed-chosen minute, photographing a labeled comet transit over open ocean together with a tide-staff serial already on-ledger. Two night clerks who have never co-signed this applicant hash the photo, the staff serial, and the transit timestamp. The bond returns after 12 days only if both hashes match and the staff serial is unused. A reused staff or the same clerk pair burns both stakes, so a clone farm pays for a fresh jetty slot on every fake name.
